about.hero_desc: Connecting passion, sharing flavors. Discover the story behind every dish with GastroWise.
about.story_p1: In a world where everything is digitized, sharing a meal together is one of the last remaining threads of real connection. It's where deals are made, friendships are forged, and romances begin.
about.story_p2: At GastroWise, our mission is simple: ensure every gathering is accompanied by great food. We don't just recommend restaurants, we recommend memories. Let us handle the menu, so you can fully dedicate your time to the people sitting across from you.
about.team_member_1_desc: The person behind the entire server system and smart AI algorithms. Specialty: Turning complex data into perfect dish recommendations and keeping the server as solid as a rock.
about.team_member_1_fav: Favorite: Matcha Latte - Energy source for coding through the night.
about.team_member_2_desc: The architect building the entire administration system and smooth user interface. Passionate about designing intuitive experiences, ensuring users always have the best experience when interacting.
about.team_member_2_fav: Favorite: Black iced coffee - The secret to keeping the server 'alive' 24/7.
about.features_desc: Vietnamese cuisine is a magical charm not only for those born in the S-shaped land, but also for international tourists. Those essences and heritages are constantly reaching further because of our enthusiasm.
